list_books.title: List books
list_books.description: List all books (memory/community books) in the billing account the client credential belongs to, with each book's id, alias, name, status, feature flags, dates and picture ids. Returns `books` plus `nextPageToken` when more remain. Use get_book for one book by id and list_pages for the pages inside a book.

page_token.description: Pagination token: the unmodified `nextPageToken` from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of books and the cursor for the next page.

books.description: Book records: id, uri, alias, name, baUri, organizationUri, accessTypes, features, status, limits, tags, created, modified, closedAt, lockedAt, eventDate, albumCount, cityCount.

nextPageToken.description: Pass as page_token to get the next page; absent on the last page.

get_book.title: Get a book
get_book.description: Get one book by its id: name, alias, configuration (preface, instructions, questions, colors, contact, disclaimer), feature/status flags, limits, tags, lifecycle timestamps and logo, cover and banner picture ids. Use list_books to find ids and get_book_analytics for engagement numbers.

book_id.description: The ID of the book, e.g. `stanford:abc-community-book` (the `id` field from list_books).

list_pages.title: List pages in a book
list_pages.description: List all pages contributed to a book, with each page's id, alias, creator name, status, share status, sections, basic info, content, media, picture/audio ids, timestamps and the `externalid` set at invitation. Returns `pages` plus `nextPageToken` when more remain. Fetch referenced pictures or audio with get_picture_file and get_audio_file.

book_id.description: The ID of the book, e.g. `stanford:abc-community-book` (the `id` field from list_books).

page_token.description: Pagination token: the unmodified `nextPageToken` from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

output.description: A page of book pages and the cursor for the next page.

pages.description: Page records: id, uri, bookUri, alias, name, status, shareStatus, sections, subheaders, basicInfo, media, content, created, modified, completedByUserAt, externalid.

nextPageToken.description: Pass as page_token to get the next page; absent on the last page.

get_book_analytics.title: Get book analytics
get_book_analytics.description: Get engagement analytics for a book over a time frame: email notification and invitation stats, web traffic values with the previous period for comparison, and book activity values. Use get_book for the book's own settings and list_pages for its contributions.

book_id.description: The ID of the book, e.g. `stanford:abc-community-book` (the `id` field from list_books).

web.description: dateRange, values and previousValues for web traffic.

book.description: values and previousValues for book activity.

get_picture_file.title: Download a picture
get_picture_file.description: Download an image referenced by a book or page (`pictureId`, `pictures[].id`, `coverPictureId`, `bannerPictureId`). Returns the image bytes; pass accept `image/webp` for WebP, otherwise JPEG or PNG per the original upload. The same image is also publicly at https://brightcrowd.com/images/<pictureId>. Use get_audio_file for audio.

picture_id.description: The ID of a picture, from a page's `pictureId` / `pictures[].id` or a book's picture fields.

accept.description: Preferred image format. Include `image/webp` to receive WebP; otherwise JPEG or PNG is returned based on the original upload.

output.description: The image file content (WebP, JPEG or PNG).

get_audio_file.title: Download an audio file
get_audio_file.description: Download an audio recording referenced by a page's `audioId`. Returns the audio bytes with its audio/* content type. Use get_picture_file for images and list_pages to find audio ids.

audio_id.description: The ID of an audio file, from a page's `audioId`.
